subject: general
question: What is the traditional bamboo dance of Mizoram called?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cheraw**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cheraw **is a very old traditional dance of **Mizoram.**
 
• It is also known as the **Bamboo dance.**
 
• It consists of usually six to eight people holding a pair of bamboo staves onto another stick of bamboo positioned horizontally on the ground.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Thang ta is a martial art from Manipur.
 
• Maanch is a dance performed in Malwa, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Yak Chaam dance is performed in Sikkim by the Bhutia community.
